title: Trump visit, Pax Silica draw more protests in Baguio

blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY — Veteran activists, Indigenous peoples’ groups, and students, including those from the University of the Philippines Baguio, gathered at Igorot Park on Monday afternoon (Nov. 16) to protest the Pax Silica initiative anew and condemn the dispersal of a protest caravan and the arrest of its participants in Muntinlupa City a day earlier.
